what: Hand adjudication of a 12-item sample drawn from the 202 accepted, non-obsoleted candidate normative-change errata, to measure the precision of the RFC-2119-keyword-delta heuristic.
sampling_note: Drawn with random.seed(11) from an unordered grouping, so the seed does not reproduce the sample. The sample is therefore recorded by errata_id. Verdicts were made by reading orig_text against correct_text, not by re-running the heuristic.

verdict_key.yes: the erratum genuinely adds, removes or changes an interoperability requirement
verdict_key.ambiguous: a normative change may be present but the keyword delta is not evidence of it

sample.note: splits STUN client behaviour into a new OAuth-client section and adds SHOULD-level constraints on parameter passing
restores a whole normative subsection (4.7, AVP flag rules) dropped when RFC 4005 was obsoleted
multi-section replacement block; the visible change is an Address Type table edit and the MUST count delta 32->29 does not localise to it
core BGP-4: non-2119 'MAY NOT' corrected to 'MUST NOT' in route-selection eligibility
rewrites which code points MUST be JSON-escaped in DNS-in-JSON names
deletes the requirement that the R flag MUST NOT be set
rewrite of 'hold-new-jobs' drops a conditional MUST-support statement
SCRAM: adds a RECOMMENDED minimum salt length and a MAY to reject longer ones; orig_text empty, i.e. a pure addition
adds 'Key Length attribute MUST NOT be specified' for ChaCha20-Poly1305 in IKE/IPsec
CoAP: adds that the Content-Format code attribute MUST NOT appear more than once in a link
adds MUST-level A-label requirements to addr-spec downgrade rewriting
correct_text is the submitter's discussion ('I am thinking splitting section 3.3...'), not replacement text; the SHOULD 1->0 delta is an artifact of that

result.caveat: n=12. A single sample of twelve pins the order of magnitude, not the second digit. Do not quote 83% as if it had a confidence interval attached.
failure_modes_found: large multi-section replacement blocks, where a net keyword-count delta does not localise to any one requirement
errata whose correct_text is prose commentary rather than replacement text
